compatibility.method: Released reference and candidate run on identical source paths/environment. Raw stdout, stderr and exit code must match; no normalization. Version/help changes are recorded separately. Candidate comparison build sets only its reported version to 0.4.0.

dircue-selected-working-tree.selection: working-tree tracked and nonignored untracked files; no .git or ignored .cache

multi-workspace.selection: hand-authored mixed workspace and malformed npm manifest

declaration_corpus.scope: Selected literal facts and deterministic acquisition, not full build evaluation or exhaustive parser conformance.

transformations: Retain final source/binary/worker/harness/fixture hashes and all individual check outcomes.
Replace embedded build receipt with reference to separately exported build-identity.json.
Omit compatibility case command paths and working directories; preserve stable case IDs, groups, process statuses and output hashes.
Omit raw stdout/stderr text; identical candidate output is represented by the original identical_to_baseline marker.
Retain interface-change commands and process/output hashes separately from the 241 exact-output cases.
Omit corpus incidental elapsed observations and warning strings; retained coverage/status/diagnostic counts qualify the successful expected-facts assertions.
Add the separately executed 16-case public-workspace corpus without modifying the original 56-case corpus; retain each harness/expectation hash.
Retain hosted Linguist check outcomes/provenance while omitting raw process payloads, Docker inspection paths and gem listings; retain image ID.
Retain hosted sample summary and provenance rather than all sample payloads; omit Enry module cache Dir/GoMod host paths; retain the native scc check receipt.
Retain the local actual-version smoke receipt unmodified inside an explicit local/non-packaged scope wrapper.
Retain a separate Cargo1.85.0 trusted synthetic oracle receipt with input and raw-output hashes; temporary-directory raw metadata paths are not included.
Add the separately executed eight-run npm workspace corpus without modifying prior56/16-run receipts; retain its own harness/expectation hashes and qualified coverage.

additional_public_workspace_corpus.scope: Selected literal facts and deterministic acquisition, not full build evaluation or exhaustive parser conformance.

hosted_checks.checkout_note: Hosted PR jobs use the GitHub merge checkout; conformance provenance records its actual ref separately from the locally measured runtime head.

linguist_samples.scope: Exploratory per-file classification, full identical content, all pinned upstream samples; not repository inclusion or universal correctness.

checks: source scope: exact full-file counters, Java/C# variants, TSX, long block comment
text scope includes detected generated/vendor/docs/XML; totals agree at every aggregation level
metrics opt-in: all without metrics retains schema 1.0.0 and omits counting
oversized eligible file yields partial coverage and contributes no prefix counts
Git HEAD and --rev metrics use committed blobs despite staged, dirty, and untracked files
large XML excluded by default without changing code totals
known_upstream_limitations: scc 4.1.0 counts the // line in RawStringLimitation.java and .cs as a comment although it is raw-string content; parity is not semantic parsing accuracy.

local_actual_version_smoke.execution_scope: Locally built Darwin ARM64 core executable, not extracted from a release archive; does not replace any native packaged-release gate.

comparison_microbenchmark.scope: Five process-warm Go benchmark replicates; not CLI startup, wall-clock total or peak RSS. No baseline speedup comparison.

local_optional_real_core_tests.evidence_scope: Observed terminal test result; no separate retained terminal-log artifact. This is not a native packaged-artifact receipt.

cargo_synthetic_oracle.isolation: Copied authored fixture in a temporary directory, empty isolated CARGO_HOME, offline networking policy; no public repository manifest executed.
cargo_synthetic_oracle.scope: Only this synthetic fixture: workspace members, default selection, inherited app version/edition/rust-version. No build, script execution, dependency fetching or complete Cargo behavior claim.

additional_npm_workspace_corpus.scope: Selected literal facts and deterministic acquisition, not full build evaluation or exhaustive parser conformance.
